Empires & Puzzles Sawano Review: The Faithful Kunoichi

Sawano brings a unique twist to the healing game: she heals your team instantly, but then keeps healing them every time an enemy dares to fire a Special Skill. Is this reactive style enough to compete with modern healers, or is she too passive for the current meta?
Sawano: The Kunoichi Who Punishes Enemy Specials

Sawano is a 5-star Ice (Blue) hero from the Ninja Tower event. Released in late 2024, she represents a shift in Ninja design towards more defensive utility. Unlike the erratic damage dealers of her family, Sawano is a dedicated support hero who wants to keep your team alive by punishing the enemy for doing what they do best: using their Special Skills. When released, Sawano was seen as "balanced" but underwhelming by a community hungry for power. She lived in the shadow of more aggressive healers or those with boosted health (like Hathor or even fellow Ninja Cobalt's pure damage output).

Today, her stat deficit is her biggest enemy. With 1705 base HP, she can be one-shot by modern snipers before she even gets a chance to dodge. Her healing percentages haven't scaled well against the massive damage output of new heroes.

If you pulled Sawano early, she is a solid healer. The Ninja mechanic can be tricky to learn, but the flexibility is powerful. Focus on charging her to x2 for the best balance of healing and cleansing.

She is likely a bench warmer for you unless you specifically need the Minion passive for War depth. She doesn't replace top-tier healers like Hathor, costume Ariel, or modern boosted healers. Do not use Alpha Aethers on her unless you are a Ninja family completionist.

Sawano is a cool concept—a healer who turns the enemy's offense into your sustain—trapped in a stat block that was outdated six months after her release. She is the "stop hitting yourself" hero of healers. While she looks the part of a deadly assassin, her role is strictly to keep the team patched up while the heavy hitters do the work. Ideally, you want her for her passive against minions, not for her raw healing output.
A situational tool for your war chest, but not a replacement for your main healers. Keep her for Minion Wars, but maybe don't give her your best troops.
